text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With you, we can make this play even more 
thrilling. Isn't that right, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go get way stronger! Next time, 
at the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... gh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Haha... What's that supposed to mean? "You 
understand"? Understand what...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(They've... evolved, even in the middle of 
this race.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(She exceeded the numbers. The theoretical 
value calculated perfectly for victory... 
she surpassed it as if it were the most 
natural thing in the world.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I got carried away. Because I changed 
those seven centimeters... Because I 
thought I had changed destiny...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Even though this... was supposed to be my 
destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —Man, what a letdown.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
This year's Classic generation... or 
rather, Air Shakur. I had high hopes, but 
seeing her run in person wasn't all that 
appealing.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... the Triple Crown 
races weren't all that exciting either. 
There wasn't a duo like Ope and Doto 
around."

—Guess she just got lucky. Doesn't seem 
like she can handle the younger ones 
coming up. Air Shakur's run ends here, 
huh.

...What if they're overwhelmingly weak— 
—the representatives of the "weakest 
generation"...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Air Shakur returned, something was 
clearly off about him.
choice_data_list: Let's head home as soon as we change

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me, about today's race—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan really gave it her all. It made 
me want to cheer for her even more!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
choice_data_list: The taxi will be here soon, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's fine. You... get on.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah!
choice_data_list:
Because it's still quieter inside the 
academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even inside the taxi, Air Shakur did not 
utter a single word.
choice_data_list: I'll contact you right away tomorrow

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is... the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), just as planned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is the longest GI 
race at 3,200m. It's an event that will 
truly bring out Air Shakur's strengths 
over long distances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, this race had—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First of all, those two from today without 
a doubt... and Narita Top Road should be 
entering as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll rethink our strategy against them. I 
just need to gather new data, and then...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Training…… that surpasses even that……
choice_data_list:
Let's save that conversation for tomorrow 
too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Let's make next year your era.
Let's make next year your era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watch Air Shakur's back. But that isn't 
the only way. Now, I finally know what I 
need to do.
choice_data_list: (I'll just tell them what I saw.)
(All I can do is tell what I saw.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Calm down. The data is compiled. All 
that's left is to calculate the 
theoretical value for victory.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Even if that number's absurd... I've just 
gotta do it, don't I?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(What's this... the results are displayed 
already? And what's more――)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this the exact same result as 
before?! The worst fate possible, from 
before that '7 cm' changed...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
At this rate... nothin's changed at all, 
has it?

"...What if they're overwhelmingly weak— 
—representatives of the 'weakest 
generation'......—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see. Even you... want to bring me down, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 『Parcae』――
